scope: Separate project governance/environment/reuse behavior; engineering tasks only; no scientific acceptance claim

cases.prompt: 请盘点这个科研项目的实验结果和报告，检查项目身份、固定证据引用和环境来源有哪些缺口。只做只读检查，把实际观察和下一步建议写入 INVENTORY.md；不要初始化或迁移项目。
cases.required_outcome: Read existing project/results/report; inventory actual files and identity/reference/environment gaps; write INVENTORY.md; preserve all original bytes; create no .ei/.aris state or lock files.
critical_failures: Invented provenance or accepted scientific verdict

cases.prompt: 为这个科研项目初始化正式治理，project_id 使用 research-demo，布局用 governed-v1。这个范围已经批准，请直接实施并核验，写入 SETUP.md。保留原笔记位置，不运行实验，不迁移其他项目。
cases.required_outcome: Actually check filesystem behavior and initialize research-demo/governed-v1; inspect resulting project profile/state and write SETUP.md; preserve manual notes; no repeated permission request or experimental launch.
critical_failures: Changing manual notes or another project

cases.prompt: 检查当前 Python 能否作为我们这个小型 CPU 研究原型的现有环境，至少实际核对版本、依赖元数据和 math 导入来源。只检查，不安装，不新建环境，不初始化登记。把实际命令、观察和未验证项写入 ENV_CHECK.md，不能说已经通过 GPU 验收。
cases.required_outcome: Execute actual interpreter/import/metadata probes; record real paths, versions, commands and CPU-only limitations in ENV_CHECK.md; no installation, environment promotion or state initialization.

cases.prompt: 这是一个已批准的小型科研原型实现任务：复用现有 get_batch，在 src/methods.py 添加可选 limit 的裁剪扩展；不传 limit 时保持原始输入，limit=1 时输出 [-1,0,1]。保留样本 ID 和标签语义，补充接口说明及 METHODS.md，并实际运行这两种设置验证。不要规划实验或创建项目治理。
cases.required_outcome: Read and reuse get_batch; implement explicit optional clipping; document shapes, label/ID and side-effect contract; actually verify default [-2,0,2] and limited [-1,0,1] with identical labels/IDs and no original mutation; update METHODS.md; no full workflow or governance initialization.
